name: The Vault beneath the Gold
description:
A piglin ledger has no word for forgiveness, but several precise words for debt.

Search bastion treasure. Prepare for the defenders before opening chests. Earn End Remastered's cursed eye advancement by obtaining the eye. This record keeps working after you use the eye. Eyes are never consumed by this quest. Loot can be random; choose other routes for the portal if a source proves elusive.
